title: Welsh Fish Pilaf
description: A comforting and earthy Welsh dish featuring tender fish, herbs, and low-carb-friendly ingredients, cooked in a sealed papillote for maximum flavor. This nutritious pilaf makes for a satisfying lunch or dinner option, perfect for a weeknight meal.

ingredients.name: Chopped leeks
ingredients.notes: white and light green parts only

ingredients.name: Dried thyme
ingredients.notes: fresh thyme can be substituted, chopped

ingredients.name: Dried parsley
ingredients.notes: fresh parsley can be substituted, chopped

instructions: Place the salmon fillets in the center of a large piece of parchment paper.
Combine the chopped leeks, rice, carrots, onion, garlic, thyme, parsley, salt, and pepper in a bowl and mix well.
Place the leek mixture around the salmon fillets, leaving a 1-inch border on all sides.
Fold the parchment paper over the ingredients and secure with kitchen twine.
Place the papillote on a baking sheet and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
